description: This file defines API route handlers for user account management in a Fastify server, including account deletion, token management, user reporting, linking/unlinking Microsoft transcript URLs, submitting surveys, and exam environment token handling.

methods.name: getMsTranscriptApiUrl
methods.description: Parses a Microsoft transcript URL to generate an API URL or return an error if invalid.

methods.name: userRoutes
methods.description: Defines API endpoints for user account management, including delete, reset progress, token management, reporting, linking/unlinking Microsoft transcript URLs, submitting surveys, and exam environment tokens.

methods.name: examEnvironmentTokenHandler
methods.description: Generates a new exam environment authorization token for the user, invalidating previous tokens.

methods.name: getExamEnvironmentToken
methods.description: Retrieves a valid exam environment token for the user if it exists.
